<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book A Metro Ticket">1fee2da1837a4b100ac7c750ceaad381</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Generate QR Code</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onSubmit() {

    var source = g_form.getDisplayValue('starting_from');
    var destination = g_form.getDisplayValue('going_to');
    var passengers = g_form.getValue('no_of_passengers');

    // Get the actual stored value
    var journeyValue = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');

    // Convert it to a readable value
    var journey = '';

    if (journeyValue == 'single') {
        journey = 'Single';
    } else if (journeyValue == 'return') {
        journey = 'Return';
    }

    // Validate journey
    if (!journeyValue) {
        alert('Please select Type of Journey.');
        return false;
    }

    // Get amount
    var amount = '';

    if (journeyValue == 'single') {
        amount = g_form.getValue('amount_for_single_journey');
    } else if (journeyValue == 'return') {
        amount = g_form.getValue('amount_including_return');
    }

    // Validate amount
    if (!amount) {
        alert('Please wait for the fare to be calculated.');
        return false;
    }

    // Ticket reference
    var ticketId = g_form.getUniqueValue();

    // Open UI Page
    var modal = new GlideModal('external_qr_api_page');

    modal.setTitle('Metro Ticket QR Code');

    modal.setPreference(
        'sysparm_ticket_id',
        ticketId
    );

    modal.setPreference(
        'sysparm_source',
        source
    );

    modal.setPreference(
        'sysparm_destination',
        destination
    );

    modal.setPreference(
        'sysparm_passengers',
        passengers
    );

    modal.setPreference(
        'sysparm_journey',
        journey
    );

    modal.setPreference(
        'sysparm_amount',
        amount
    );

    modal.setWidth(550);

    modal.render();

    return false;
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-19 10:12:54</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>936822a183728b100ac7c750ceaad3d3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Generate QR Code</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_936822a183728b100ac7c750ceaad3d3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-22 16:29:58</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

     *   Return Fare         = ₹100
     *   Total Fare          = ₹100

     * Return Journey:
     *   Single Journey Fare = ₹0
     *   Return Fare         = ₹100

     * Passenger count and route do not change
     * the base fare in this version.
     */

    var journeyType = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');

    // Always start with a clean state
    g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
    g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

    // No journey selected
    if (!journeyType) {
        return;
    }

    // Single Journey
    if (journeyType == 'single') {

        g_form.setValue(
            'amount_for_single_journey',
            '0'
        );

        g_form.setValue(
            'amount_including_return',
            '100'
        );
    }

    // Return Journey
    else if (journeyType == 'return') {

        g_form.setValue(
            'amount_for_single_journey',
            '0'
        );

        g_form.setValue(
            'amount_including_return',
            '100'
        );
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-20 18:06:24</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>395e154283f64f100ac7c750ceaad30b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Initialize Metro Fare</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_395e154283f64f100ac7c750ceaad30b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-25 07:48:36</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
